### Added
- **`muster test` dumps its goroutines while a call is blocked past its deadline.** A stalled call's diagnostics (#1260) were taken after the call had unwound, so the blocked frame was gone. In CI a poll with a 20s budget came back only after 90s, and muster serve never logged its request. The call ignored its context somewhere in the harness's client path. A call to muster serve that is still running 2s after its context's deadline now has the harness's goroutines recorded while it is blocked, as `harness_goroutines_at_overrun` in the report, and the failure line points at it. ([#1206](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1206))
